summary: 11:30 PM ET run, published at 12:05 ET. Both week 3 picks are settled from ESPN box scores: Texas A&M -16.5 at -118 lost, Kentucky winning outright 31-21, and Duke -10 at -105 won, 35-7. The day is 1-1 and -0.05 units at the published prices. Nothing was closed: neither line moved before kickoff. No new picks; the NFL card waits for Sunday morning, when inactives are out. Week 3 is not complete, with eight college games still in play at midnight, so the weekly review waits for the first run after they finish. The Odds API captured all 29 NFL games at midnight, 486 credits left this month.

takeaways: How the day's documented passes finished, from ESPN box scores: Louisiana Tech at Baylor went over 49.5 (55 points), Ohio at South Alabama went over 48.5 (77), FIU covered +6.5 losing 16-10, and LSU at Ole Miss stayed under 58.5 (56). West Virginia and Virginia went over 53.5 (65), the one pass that was right. Four of the five model leans we passed on would have won. Five games is noise, not evidence, and the reasons for passing were sourced (backup quarterbacks, hurt quarterbacks, no reason beyond the model). It is worth watching whether passing on totals after the market has moved on news is costing more than it saves.

Both picks were published at 8:45 AM with quotes that expired at 11:30 AM, and neither line moved all day: Texas A&M held at -16.5 -118 and Duke at -10 -105 at DraftKings through the 12:25 PM and 6:03 PM captures.
